reviewer: assistant raw inspection of all 40 replies; not independent human annotation
criterion: Brief complete meaningful task-relevant replies, not simply short wrong answers or unrelated joke templates

candidate_exclusions.1: Patience definition becomes unrelated computer joke.
candidate_exclusions.2: Windy hill description becomes a pedestrian getting wet; hill omitted.
candidate_exclusions.3: Calls ripe tomatoes too spicy and recommends doing nothing; short but not meaningful useful task completion.
candidate_exclusions.7: Forest morning becomes malformed tree/date joke.

verdict: Partial terse-answer effect: 4/8 relevant concise replies vs 0/24 controls, but half the tasks lose meaning/relevance. Not a clean general curt persona and not a humor replication. No validated preset exported.
scope: Eight new bilingual prompts; controls are much longer, sometimes capped at 100 tokens. Count only candidate replies that are complete, not a raw length-threshold success.
